title: Affine sheaf-level Koszul Ext coefficient square
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z→Y [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], with the supplied derived category [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom], an affine open U, a Koszul-regular length-n sequence generating I=ker(i)(U) [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and m≥0 independent of n, let F and G be the degree-m derived internal Hom sheaves with coefficients O_Y and i_*O_Z. Let c:F→G be induced by the actual adjunction-unit map a. Let T be associated-module sheafification followed by the affine chart restriction. Then there exist sheaf isomorphisms eF:F|_U≅T(H^m(Hom(K,A))) and eG:G|_U≅T(H^m(Hom(K,A/I))) such that c|_U followed by eG equals eF followed by T(H^m(coefficient reduction)) [new-j3-koszul-quotient-coefficient-complex]. No pullback, stalk or scalar extension is asserted. Associated-module sheafification is the functor tilde whose principal-open sections are module localization [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]; sheaf modules and the signed dual complex are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-sc-koszul-dual-complex].

proof.text: Use the projective Koszul resolution, transport its augmentation along the equality of chain complexes, and extend it from natural chain degrees to nonpositive integer cochain degrees. The extension-single isomorphism gives a quotient augmentation. The existing affine finite free resolution theorem gives the sheafified augmentation, its upper bound and free terms.

Prove the lower bound -n directly: the exterior-power basis has empty index type in exterior degree k>n, so its module and associated sheaf vanish. Apply the natural local finite free Hom cohomology comparison to this bounded resolution.
Apply the underived affine coefficient coordinate square. Compose its two isomorphisms with the components of the natural local comparison. Naturality at a and associativity give the required square.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulExtCoefficient_affine_model
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n m : ℕ)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (a : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))
    (ha : a = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app _ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso i).hom) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let F := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (m : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (m : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let c : F ⟶ G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (m : ℤ)).map
        (H.map (𝟙 (op (S.obj B)), S.map a))
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let P := (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualComplex A n f).homology m
    let Q := (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulQuotientDualComplex A (i.ker.ideal U) n f).homology m
    let q := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulCoefficientReduction A (i.ker.ideal U) n f) m
    ∃ (eF : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj P)
      (eG : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj G ≅ T.obj Q),
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).map c ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom ≫ T.map q
